# Caleb Pierre — Business Automation Engineer
# Caleb Pierre / Los Angeles, CA / Web, AI, Automation, Marketing, Support, Events & Security

> Caleb Pierre is a Business Automation Engineer based in Los Angeles, CA. He builds the web, AI, automation, marketing, and support systems that let a business run itself — for organizations across LA County, from enterprise security teams to nonprofit organizations. 10 years of experience across Tinder (Security Engineer II), Verizon Media, Children's Hospital LA, Glass Financial (CTO), and now Caleb Pierre Ventures.

## Core Services
- Web Design: Next.js, React, Tailwind — sites built to convert, not just to look nice. Deployed on AWS/GCP with Docker, CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
- AI Programming: Custom AI agents that do real work — LLM orchestration, MCP integration, RAG pipelines, and multi-agent workflows. Eliminates 40-60% of manual overhead.
- Business Automation: Zapier, n8n, Make, and custom Python agents connecting disparate systems into unified, self-operating infrastructure.
- Content Marketing: Content systems that compound — SEO-optimized articles, programmatic landing pages, and AI-crawler-friendly llms.txt protocol.
- Remote Tech Support: A real engineer on call, not a ticket number.
- Experience / Event Design: Launches, activations, and experiences designed and run end-to-end.
- Cybersecurity: SOAR/SIEM (Splunk, QRadar), Zero Trust Architecture, HIPAA/HiTECH compliance, vulnerability assessment, incident response.
